svg.title: Swirling night sky with stars and a crescent moon over rolling fields and golden wheat
svg.desc: Original artwork generated with AI assistance (SI) for CropShift RESILIENCE, in the manner of Post-Impressionist oil painting and inspired by Vincent van Gogh's The Starry Night (1889, public domain). Not a reproduction of any painting. The landscape is imaginary and is not the project's pilot site.
svg.text: Original AI-generated artwork (SI) · after Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night (1889) · imaginary landscape
